rulings.restated: Input — Do you want to claim any credit other than the foreign tax credit claimed without Form 1116, the excess social security credit, the child tax credit, the credit for other dependents, the additional child tax credit and the earned income credit, or do you have any other amount for Schedule 3 Part I (for example a Form 8978 adjustment)?
rulings.model: This is a filer-answered scope question, and its label and restatement agree. Form 1040 lines 19, 20, 27a, 28 and 31 confirm the Schedule 8812, Schedule 3 and EIC credit lines. However, Schedule 3, Form 1116 and Form 8978 text are not provided, so the credits excluded and retained cannot be checked against IRS wording.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: unclear for want of text; restatement accepted. A filer-answered scope question whose wording the model found consistent with the Form 1040 lines it could see; the items it lists are the refusals recorded in spec 2.1 and on the lines that read this question, each cited there. The Schedule 1 and Schedule 3 instructions are cited by those lines, not by the question.

rulings.restated: Input — Any income or adjustment requiring Schedule 1 other than business income or loss from Schedule C, unemployment compensation, educator expenses, the HSA deduction, the deductible part of self-employment tax, self-employed SEP and SIMPLE contributions, the self-employed health insurance deduction and student loan interest, including a taxable state or local tax refund; alimony; an IRA deduction; statutory-employee wages or clergy income; church employee income (wages from a church that elected exemption from social security and Medicare taxes); other qualified retirement plans for the self-employed (such as a solo 401(k) or other Keogh plan); rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, estates or trusts (Schedule E or a Schedule K-1); rental of personal property; farm income (Schedule F); gambling winnings, prizes or other income for Schedule 1 line 8; or an exclusion of Medicaid waiver payments (Schedule 1 line 8s)? (Schedule 1-A deductions are asked separately.)
rulings.model: This is a filer-answered scope question, and its label and restatement agree. Form 1040 line 8 ('Additional income from Schedule 1, line 10') and line 10 ('Adjustments to income from Schedule 1, line 26') confirm that Schedule 1 feeds the return. However, Schedule 1 and its instructions are not provided, so the listed items (for example Schedule 1 line 8 and line 8s, Medicaid waiver exclusion, church employee income) cannot be checked against IRS wording.
